title: Scramble title (HyperFrames block)
description: A thin title decodes letter by letter (GSAP ScrambleText) and a gold rule draws under it (DrawSVG). It is a HyperFrames-format block, HTML + CSS + a paused GSAP timeline, played as it is.

source.note: our own block in the HyperFrames format; blocks from heygen-com/hyperframes (Apache-2.0) run the same way
